name: cartularium
description: cartularium monorepo; spreadsheet tools and projects

scripts.dev: CARTULARIUM_HOME_URL=${CARTULARIUM_HOME_URL:-http://localhost:8080} CARTULARIUM_WIKI_URL=${CARTULARIUM_WIKI_URL:-http://localhost:8081} CARTULARIUM_ASSAY_URL=${CARTULARIUM_ASSAY_URL:-http://localhost:8082} CARTULARIUM_ASSAY_REF_MODE=${CARTULARIUM_ASSAY_REF_MODE:-degraded} concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names 'home,wiki,assay,editor,shell' --prefix-colors 'magenta,blue,green,yellow,red' 'pnpm --filter @cartularium/cartularium-org serve' 'pnpm --filter sheets-wiki serve' 'pnpm --filter assay serve' 'pnpm --filter @cartularium/sheets-wiki-editor dev' 'pnpm --filter @cartularium/edit-shell dev'
scripts.dev:runner: pnpm --filter assay build && cd packages/assay && node build/cli.js preview-worker --base-url http://localhost:8083/api/edit --token "$ASSAY_RUNNER_TOKEN" --platform hyperformula --poll-ms 5000 --runner-id local-dev-runner
scripts.predev: bash scripts/coord-status.sh --brief 2>/dev/null || true ; pnpm --filter @cartularium/edit-shell exec wrangler d1 migrations apply cartularium-assay-preview --local
